card.name: Diluent volume in preparation steps
card.fires_on: The small linking word or space right after a dissolve, dilute, or add instruction, just before the diluent volume or name (such as 100 mL or 0.9% Sodium Chloride).

modes.label: Before a volume
modes.description: A space or word like in, to, or into sits just before a number and mL for the final volume.
modes.example: Dilute the contents of the three reconstituted vials (approximately 3 × 15 mL) into<< >>210 mL of 5%

modes.label: Before the diluent
modes.description: A linking word such as in, with, or a comes just before the name of the diluent.
modes.example: Dissolve contents of one 0.5 mg vial<< with>> 5 mL of Sterile Water for

card.writes: It pushes toward sterile-diluent words starting with Ster and away from words like mean.
card.plain: It fires on the small word in a mixing instruction, just before the amount or fluid to mix the drug into.
